items.passage: Where agents are real and productive is in engineering. Software teams are seeing actual gains. That's created a bifurcation of worlds. Engineers feel like they're living in the future and can see how an agent might take their job. Everyone else, doing work that's less rules-based, less structured, less deterministic, is much further from disruption than the headlines suggest.

items.passage: Step three is ownership, and this is where most companies are flying blind. The organizations figuring this out have an AI lead who is AI-native, or close to it, overseeing usage across the company. When AI lives inside the legacy IT department, you get process and compliance. Experimentation and cost discipline come from giving it its own home.
